_apa_ini: The six rerankers as they ran: weight revision, license, architecture, precision, token budget, template, and scoring path.

sumber_setiap_kolom.revisi: local Hugging Face cache, one snapshot per model, refs/main points to it
sumber_setiap_kolom.lisensi_dan_base: front matter of the model card in the same snapshot
sumber_setiap_kolom.presisi_anggaran_template_skor: closing manifest of the paired both cell of each model

offline: every run set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, so the weights loaded are that snapshot

model.sumber_anggaran_token: default --max-len of the arm scoring script, never changed in any command
model.aturan_skor: softmax of the yes and no logits
model.jalur: own harness, vendor template copied verbatim, run locally

model.sumber_anggaran_token: default --max-len of the arm scoring script, never changed in any command
model.aturan_skor: softmax of the yes and no logits
model.jalur: own harness, vendor template copied verbatim, run locally

model.sumber_template: chat_template.jinja + 1_LogitScore/config.json of the official repo, applied by the vendor library
README of jhu-clsp/FollowIR-7B, template and scoring copied verbatim
model.format_template:
<s> [INST] You are an expert Google searcher, whose job is to determine if the following document is relevant to the query (true/false). Answer using only one word, one of those two choices.

Query: {query}
Document: {text}
Relevant (only output one word, either "true" or "false"): [/INST]
model.aturan_skor: softmax(logit false, logit true)[true] at the last position
model.jalur: own harness, vendor template copied verbatim, run locally

model.sumber_template: README of ContextualAI ctxl-rerank-v2, the Transformers path infer_w_hf copied verbatim
model.aturan_skor: logit of token id 0 at the last position, cast to bfloat16 and then to float
model.jalur: own harness, vendor template copied verbatim, run locally

model.sumber_template: README of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-gemma, get_inputs function adapted (see NOTICE.md)
model.aturan_skor: raw logit of the token 'Yes' at the last position, no softmax
model.jalur: own harness, vendor template copied verbatim, run locally

embedder.catatan: the two snapshots in the cache and the frozen record (env_versions.json) name only 'BAAI/bge-m3 fp16' without a revision, so which snapshot built the index cannot be settled from the files

label_source: deterministic (read from the model cache and the run manifests)
